data.name: Empowered in Fear
data.description: Your horror is treated as if under the effect of physical acceleration any time it is within 30 ft. of a shaken, frightened, or panicked creature.

raw_tokens.value: Your horror is treated as if under the effect of physical acceleration any time it is within 30 ft. of a shaken, frightened, or panicked creature.

Your horror is also treated as if under the form of doom power when within 30 ft. of a shaken, frightened, or panicked creature.  This effect allows the horror to have more natural attacks than its normal eidolon form limit.
